title: Which Disney Character Are You?
description: Answer 12 questions to discover your Disney character!

options.text: Plan a picnic with friends and meet new people
Stay home, read a book, and enjoy quiet time
Organize your closet and try new DIY projects
Daydream about visiting far-off lands and adventures

questions.text: When a friend is upset, you...

options.text: Hug them and say, 'I’m here for you no matter what'
Ask, 'What’s the root problem? Let’s fix it step by step'
Suggest a specific plan: 'Let’s get coffee tomorrow to talk'
Go with the flow—maybe watch a movie or take a walk together
Collaborating with a team to bring ideas to life
Working alone to perfect every detail
Using practical skills to build something tangible
Imagining bold, creative concepts that push boundaries

questions.text: If your plans get canceled last minute, you...

options.text: Feel disappointed but quickly call a friend to hang out
Analyze why it happened and adjust your schedule logically
Pull out your backup plan you prepared just in case
See it as a chance to explore spontaneous activities

questions.text: At a party, you’re most likely to...

options.text: Dance, tell stories, and make sure everyone’s having fun
Sit in a corner with a few close friends and chat deeply
Notice the decor, snacks, and little details that make the party special
Imagine how the party could be even more magical with themes or games

questions.text: When making a big choice, you prioritize...

options.text: How it makes you and others feel deep down
Facts, data, and what makes the most logical sense
Sticking to a timeline and clear goals you’ve set
Leaving room for unexpected opportunities to arise

Creating fantasy worlds in your head or writing stories

Propose a vote or follow the group’s agreed-upon rules
Let the conversation flow and see where it leads naturally

questions.text: Choosing a gift for a friend, you...

options.text: Pick something they mentioned needing recently
Create a custom gift that reflects their dreams or passions

results.title: Mickey Mouse
results.description: You’re the heart of any group—optimistic, outgoing, and always ready to spread joy. Like Mickey, you thrive in social settings, use your creativity to solve problems, and stay loyal to your friends. You’re an ESFJ: warm, organized, and naturally inclined to take care of others.

results.title: Elsa
results.description: You’re introspective and deeply thoughtful, with a quiet strength that inspires others. Like Elsa, you value your independence but learn to open up, using your unique gifts to protect those you love. You’re an INFJ: intuitive, compassionate, and driven by a sense of purpose.

results.title: Simba
results.description: You’re bold, energetic, and love adventure—always ready to leap into new experiences. Like Simba, you balance confidence with heart, learning to take responsibility while staying true to your playful spirit. You’re an ESTP: practical, action-oriented, and the life of the party.

results.title: Belle
results.description: You’re curious, imaginative, and see the beauty in others beyond first impressions. Like Belle, you love learning, value deep connections, and stand up for what’s right. You’re an INFP: idealistic, creative, and driven by a desire to make the world more compassionate.

results.title: Tiana
results.description: You’re hardworking, determined, and turn dreams into reality with grit and patience. Like Tiana, you believe in earning success through effort, stay grounded in practicality, and never lose sight of your goals. You’re an ESTJ: organized, responsible, and a natural leader.

results.title: Moana
results.description: You’re adventurous, brave, and have a deep connection to your roots and the world around you. Like Moana, you trust your instincts, embrace change, and inspire others to follow their hearts. You’re an ESFP: energetic, spontaneous, and always ready for a new journey.

results.title: Aladdin
results.description: You’re quick-witted, resourceful, and thrive on thinking outside the box. Like Aladdin, you use your creativity to overcome challenges, care deeply for your loved ones, and dream of a better future. You’re an ENTP: clever, adaptable, and always up for a mental challenge.

results.title: Jasmine
results.description: You’re confident, independent, and unafraid to speak your mind. Like Jasmine, you value freedom, stand up for justice, and bring warmth and passion to everything you do. You’re an ENFJ: charismatic, empathetic, and a natural leader who lifts others up.

results.title: Winnie the Pooh
results.description: You’re kind, gentle, and find joy in life’s simple pleasures. Like Pooh, you’re loyal to your friends, approach problems with a calm heart, and believe in the power of love and friendship. You’re an ISFP: artistic, compassionate, and deeply in tune with your emotions.

results.title: Piglet
results.description: You’re shy, thoughtful, and care deeply about those around you. Like Piglet, you may doubt yourself at times, but your courage shines when your friends need you. You’re an INFP: sensitive, creative, and quietly brave in your own way.

results.title: Beast
results.description: You’re complex, loyal, and have a soft heart hidden beneath a tough exterior. Like the Beast, you learn to let go of pride, embrace vulnerability, and protect what matters most. You’re an ISTJ: responsible, detail-oriented, and fiercely devoted to those you love.

results.title: Cinderella
results.description: You’re kind, resilient, and maintain grace even in difficult times. Like Cinderella, you believe in kindness, stay hopeful, and trust that good things come to those who wait. You’re an ISFJ: nurturing, reliable, and always willing to help others.

results.title: Nala
results.description: You’re strong, loyal, and a trusted friend who keeps others grounded. Like Nala, you balance courage with compassion, speak your mind, and stand by your loved ones through thick and thin. You’re an ESFJ: supportive, practical, and the glue that holds your group together.

results.title: Maui
results.description: You’re bold, confident, and love showing off your skills—though deep down, you crave connection. Like Maui, you use your talents to help others, embrace your flaws, and find strength in being true to yourself. You’re an ESTP: energetic, charismatic, and always up for a challenge.

results.title: Anna
results.description: You’re optimistic, outgoing, and wear your heart on your sleeve. Like Anna, you approach life with enthusiasm, believe in second chances, and bring light to even the darkest situations. You’re an ENFP: creative, passionate, and always seeing the best in people.

results.title: Minnie Mouse
results.description: You’re sweet, caring, and have a knack for making everyone feel special. Like Minnie, you’re organized, thoughtful, and find joy in small acts of kindness. You’re an ISFJ: gentle, reliable, and the heart of your circle of friends.

share_hook: Most people score the same result on this Which Disney Character Are You? quiz, but about one in five ends up in a totally different bucket.
